description: This file defines a PHP class named tlRequirementFilterControl, which extends tlFilterControl and manages filtering logic for requirement trees within the TestLink project. It includes methods for configuration, initializing filters and settings, and building requirement tree menus at the GUI level. The class is specific to handling requirements-related filters and GUI interactions within the TestLink software.

classes.name: tlRequirementFilterControl
classes.description: A class extending tlFilterControl, tailored for managing requirement tree filters and GUI logic in TestLink.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the tlRequirementFilterControl object, setting up requirement manager and filters.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Cleans up resources when the object is destroyed.

methods.name: read_config
methods.description: Loads configuration data for requirement filters.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Prepares request parameters for filtering and settings.

methods.name: init_settings
methods.description: Initializes active settings based on configuration and input.

methods.name: init_filters
methods.description: Initializes active filters based on configuration and input.

methods.name: get_active_filters
methods.description: Returns the array of currently active filters.

methods.name: build_tree_menu
methods.description: Constructs and assigns the requirement tree menu for the GUI based on active filters.

methods.name: init_setting_refresh_tree_on_action
methods.description: Initializes the 'refresh tree on action' setting.

methods.name: init_filter_tc_id
methods.description: Initializes the test case ID filter.

methods.name: getCustomFields
methods.description: Fetches linked custom fields for requirements in the current test project.
